_note: Akana demo catalogue plan. Invented authors, imprints and books are marked is_demo. Classics are real public-domain texts with new Akana workbooks. Maya Vaughn's 20 workbooks stay in content/catalog/catalog.json and are not repeated here. Prices are tiers only; figures are for Crent to set.
prepared_by: Editorial Director with the Naming Strategist, Legal Lead and Clinical Safety Lead (agents)
code_rule: AK-, AU- and PB- plus five Crockford base32 characters from sha256('akana:<key>:n'), least significant digit first, n raised on collision. Checked against the 20 minted codes.

price_tiers.amounts: [Crent] GBP lead price per tier, local prices per markets.json
